text:
alex_dev: Heads up — we're seeing a strange SSE reconnect case when requests go through the new edge buffer layer. Clients show as 'resumed' but the client receives a duplicate of the last event and billing increments twice. Repro is easy: start stream, forcibly close mid-event, reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

mira: This is the buffer rollout from yesterday, right? Could be the chunk coalescing change. :eyes:

jonas: I can repro locally by proxying through the buffer and injecting a TCP kill right after a partial event. Proxy logs show it rewrites the Last-Event-ID and mangles the frame boundary.

gina: example snippet from edge-proxy logs:

```
[2026-03-19T22:04:01Z] [edge-proxy] INFO  stream: received fragment "data: {\"id\":\"evt-123\", ...\n"
[2026-03-19T22:04:01Z] [edge-proxy] DEBUG rewrite: header Last-Event-ID -> resume-id: 'evt-123' -> 'evt-123\n'
[2026-03-19T22:04:01Z] [edge-proxy] WARN  stream: partial-frame boundary lost, buffering
```

ryan: Quick mitigation: stop normalizing newline chars on Last-Event-ID and treat it as opaque. Also emit a metric `sse.resume_header_normalized` so we can count how often the proxy touches it.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout: edge-buffer v2 -> 2% prod (us-east-1) started by @gina

alex_dev: Also related: the console marks a stream as 'resumed' as soon as connection is re-established. We should not mark success until the server accepts the resume token (ACK). Right now UI gives false positive which hides duplicates.

mira: Agreed. New UI state suggestion: `resuming-pending-ack` with spinner; only change to `resumed` on explicit server ack event. We should add telemetry: `sse.resume_handshake_duration_ms` and `sse.resume_failed_count`.

jonas: I'll file a tiny RFC for two changes: (1) proxy: preserve Last-Event-ID bytes exactly, no newline normalization; (2) console: add `resuming-pending-ack` state + telemetry. Patch sketch ready.

gina: I'll pause the rollout on us-east canary and coordinate a hotfix canary once jonas pushes. Also need someone to audit billing/token redemption — duplicate delivery looks like it triggers the billing increment path twice. @alex_dev can you take point?

alex_dev: Yep, I'll audit billing flow and add a guard to idempotent-redeem resume tokens. I'll also own the console changes.

ryan: Add an integration test to nightly: simulate partial-frame across proxy + reconnect with Last-Event-ID and assert exactly-once semantic. I'm on it.

gina: ops will hold rollout and run canary when patches land. I'll post canary results in this thread. :thumbsup:

jonas: PR opened: edge-proxy #4123 — preserve-last-event-id config flag + unit tests.

alex_dev: Thanks. Action items: jonas -> proxy patch, gina -> canary/rollout control, ryan -> nightly integration test, mira -> telemetry + console UX, alex_dev -> billing idempotency. Ping me for handoff.

ops-bot: NOTE: incident created id=INC-2026-034 for tracking duplicate-delivery billing reports

alex_dev: will follow up with a short postmortem once we confirm fix.
